oss.method_verbatim: no MCMP in the OSS repository (no component index, no component transport equation); the two-component layered Poiseuille benchmark cannot be mapped directly. Only the phase-field layered-initialisation geometry and the variable-density equilibrium assembly can be borrowed, i.e. 'two-component' is downgraded to 'two-phase layered'.
oss.conventions_verbatim: no component index / no per-component PDF; the layering is given only by the initial value of C
oss.upstream_note: lssfau/walberla is not reachable from this sandbox (no network, no vendored copy in this worktree); the OSS arm is therefore specified from the inventory row above and implemented as the single-distribution model M2P, not by compiling the OSS binary. This is a limitation of the study and is stated as such in the report.

decision: Decide whether the no-MCMP two-phase-only downgrade (one distribution function, frozen phase indicator C, local viscosity from C, variable-density equilibrium assembly) may stand in for the two-component layered Poiseuille analytic benchmark inside the owner 15% band -- or whether a component-resolved (MCMP) model is required for viscosity-stratified internal flows.
alternatives: A1 two-layer analytic reference (4x4 linear system for the piecewise-parabolic Stokes solution; machine-checked wall/continuity/stress invariants)
A2 two-phase-only model M2P with node-local viscosity mixing rule harmonic
A3 two-phase-only model M2P with mixing rule geometric
A4 two-phase-only model M2P with mixing rule linear
A5 MCMP two-component Shan-Chen (library collide_sc_two_component, u_eq=mixture, Guo forcing) at the same viscosity ratio
A6 density-contrast variant of M2P (rho_hi = 0.25 rho_lo) -- structural diagnostic of the downgrade

hypothesis.H1: M2P reproduces the two-layer analytic profile within the owner 15% band (L2 relative error on the velocity profile, peak-normalised max error, per-layer flux) for viscosity ratios nu_lo/nu_hi <= 4 with an interface width of >= 2 cells.
hypothesis.H2: The profile error grows monotonically with the viscosity ratio at fixed interface width.
hypothesis.H3: The node-local viscosity mixing rule is load-bearing: at fixed nu_ratio >= 4 the linear rule is the worst and the harmonic rule the best.
hypothesis.H4: At nu_ratio = 10 at least one mixing rule leaves the 15% band, i.e. the downgrade is not universally acceptable.
hypothesis.H5: A density contrast across the frozen interface degrades the two-phase-only arm, because the model has no interface-sharpening mechanism and the density profile diffuses.

metrics.K1_analytic_selfcheck: max over cases of the four analytic residuals (wall_low, wall_high, |u jump| at the interface, |mu du/dy jump|) -- must be at machine precision, since the reference is solved, not transcribed. Cross-check: the generic 4x4 solver vs tensorlbm.porous_media._two_phase_poiseuille_analytical at the legacy convention (walls at j=0 and j=ny-1, interface at ny//2).
metrics.K2_l2_rel: ||u_sim - u_ana||_2 / ||u_ana||_2 over the fluid nodes j=1..ny-2 (steady profile averaged over the periodic x direction)
metrics.K3_max_rel_peak: max_j |u_sim - u_ana| / max_j |u_ana| over the same nodes
metrics.K4_flux_rel: |Q_sigma,sim - Q_sigma,ana| / |Q_sigma,ana| per layer, Q_sigma = sum over the layer of rho u_x
metrics.K5_uy_spurious_rel: max|u_y| / max|u_x| -- validity check of the frozen-interface assumption (a parallel flow must have a vanishing normal velocity)
metrics.K6_mass_drift_rel: |sum rho(final) - sum rho(initial)| / sum rho(initial) over the fluid nodes
metrics.K7_resolution: l2_rel at ny=96 vs ny=48 at nu_ratio=2 (grid trend)
metrics.K8_density_contrast: same K2/K3 on the rho_hi=0.25 arm, plus the measured interface 10-90 width and centre drift of the density profile

predeclared_thresholds.interpretation: 0.15 is the owner band (relative error above 15% is not acceptable). K1 is a semantics/exactness check and is therefore at machine precision. Diagnostics that no threshold can decide a priori (interface width growth, convergence history) are reported as numbers only.

solver_settings.geometry: wall rows j=0 and j=ny-1 (full-way bounce-back, no-slip planes at y=0 and y=ny-1 in lattice units); interface at y_int=(ny-1)/2; frozen phase indicator C = 0.5(1 - tanh((y-y_int)/width))
solver_settings.forcing: force density rho*G with G the per-unit-mass body acceleration, Guo second-order source term with the local (tensor) tau

stopping_rule: Every arm of the four predeclared matrices is run to completion or to its step cap; no case is added or dropped after the errors are seen. Arms that hit the step cap are flagged converged=false and reported as such (no silent trimming of unconverged cases). Wall-clock per arm is recorded.
provenance: all numbers in the report are rendered from xval/XVAL-LBM-NO-MCMP-TWO-PHASE-ONLY/results.json by run_xval.render_report(); the test suite re-renders and compares, so the tables cannot be hand-edited.
